g.aria-label: Scout Explores Tennessee

Families who buy this book may print or photocopy the
coloring pages for use by children in their own household.
No part of this book may be resold, shared online or
reproduced for commercial or classroom distribution
without written permission from the publisher.
The cities, towns and nicknames were chosen to show East,
Middle and West Tennessee. The fun facts were checked in
October 2026 and are written simply for young readers.
The illustrations are vector line art drawn with the help of
AI tools, then checked page by page and cleaned up for
young colorists.
Note for grown-ups: every coloring page has a blank back,
so markers and felt-tips won't spoil the next picture. Slip a
sheet of card behind the page for extra protection.
First edition, October 2026.
Tennessee became the 16th state on June 1, 1796 —
let's explore it together!
JCF Publishing
